issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect an assembleBookstore function with the signature `assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore` (the template even contains a commented stub with no parameters). In the solution repository the function is declared as `private static func assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore` (has an extra `count` parameter), while the solution's own `main()` calls `assembleBookstore()` with no arguments. This mismatch (a parameter present in the declaration but not in the expected signature and not supplied at the call site) is a structural inconsistency that will confuse students about the required signature and causes a compile error in the solution as written.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature consistent across artifacts. Either remove the unused `count: Int` parameter in the solution (change to `private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore`) so it matches the template and problem statement and the call in main, or update the template/problem to document and show the required parameter and update all call sites accordingly. The simpler fix is to remove the `count` parameter from the solution.
